en: The hill is moving in waves. The cattle have decided not to notice.
was: Igquma linyakaza ngamagagasi. Izinkomo zinqume ukungaboni lutho.
rewrite: Igquma linyakaza okwamagagasi. Izinkomo zinqume ukunganaki.

judge.reason: 'ngamagagasi' (by means of waves) is stiff, a speaker says 'okwamagagasi' (like waves); 'ukungaboni lutho' is 'to see nothing', 'not to notice' is 'ukunganaki'.
judge.rewrite: Igquma linyakaza okwamagagasi. Izinkomo zinqume ukunganaki.

bt.bt: The [?igquma] shakes like waves. The cattle have decided not to care.

en: The moon keeps popping out to check on the forecourt. Still nothing happening.
was: Inyanga ihlala iphuma izobheka igaraji likaphethiloli. Akukho okwenzekayo.
rewrite: Inyanga ihlala iphuma izobheka egaraji. Namanje akukho okwenzekayo.

judge.reason: 'igaraji likaphethiloli' is redundant, people just say 'egaraji'; the turn needs 'still' ('Namanje') or the second beat goes flat.
judge.rewrite: Inyanga ihlala iphuma izobheka egaraji. Namanje akukho okwenzekayo.

bt.bt: The moon always comes out to look at the garage. Even now nothing is happening.

en: The sky's putting on a show. The fish, as usual, are not.
was: Isibhakabhaka senza umbukiso. Izinhlanzi, njengenjwayelo, azenzi.
rewrite: Isibhakabhaka senza umbukiso. Izinhlanzi zona, njengenjwayelo, aziwenzi.

judge.reason: 'azenzi' with no object reads as 'they don't do' and loses the show; needs the object concord 'aziwenzi' (they don't put it on) and contrastive 'zona'.
judge.rewrite: Isibhakabhaka senza umbukiso. Izinhlanzi zona, njengenjwayelo, aziwenzi.

bt.bt: The sky is putting on a show. The fish, as usual, are not.

en: The moon switched the mountains on. The heat, however, stays off.
was: Inyanga ikhanyise izintaba. Kodwa ukushisa akuvulwanga.
rewrite: Inyanga ikhanyise izintaba. Kodwa ukufudumala kona kusacishiwe.

judge.reason: 'ukushisa akuvulwanga' (the heat was not opened) is odd, heat is not switched on; keep the switch image with warmth that is still switched off ('kusacishiwe').
judge.rewrite: Inyanga ikhanyise izintaba. Kodwa ukufudumala kona kusacishiwe.

bt.bt: The moon has lit up the mountains. But the warmth is still switched off.

en: The washing should have come in hours ago. The breeze voted to leave it.
was: Izingubo bezifanele zingene emahoreni adlule. Umoya omncane uvote ukuthi zisale.
rewrite: Izingubo bekufanele zingeniswe emahoreni edlule. Umoya omncane uvotele ukuthi zihlale ngaphandle.

judge.reason: 'bezifanele zingene emahoreni adlule' is stiff; a speaker says 'bekufanele zingeniswe' and 'uvotele ukuthi zihlale ngaphandle'.
judge.rewrite: Izingubo bekufanele zingeniswe emahoreni edlule. Umoya omncane uvotele ukuthi zihlale ngaphandle.

bt.bt: The washing should have been brought in hours ago. A little wind voted that it stay outside.

en: The moon drops in between clouds. It can smell the meat from up there.
was: Inyanga ivakashela phakathi kwamafu. Iyalizwa iphunga lenyama isezulwini.
rewrite: Inyanga iqhamuka phakathi kwamafu. Iyalizwa iphunga lenyama ikude phezulu.

judge.reason: 'ivakashela phakathi kwamafu' uses the applied verb with no one being visited; a speaker says the moon 'iqhamuka' (pops out) between clouds.
judge.rewrite: Inyanga iqhamuka phakathi kwamafu. Iyalizwa iphunga lenyama ikude phezulu.

bt.bt: The moon appears between the clouds. It smells the scent of meat far up high.

en: The Friendly City never asked to be the Windy City, and yet.
was: Idolobha Elinobungane alikaze licele ukuba yiDolobha Elinomoya, kodwa noma kunjalo.
rewrite: I-Friendly City ayikaze icele ukuba yi-Windy City, kodwa manje isiyiyo.

judge.reason: City nicknames translated literally are not what people call it, and the trailing 'kodwa noma kunjalo' dangles unfinished in isiZulu; keep the names and close the turn.
judge.rewrite: I-Friendly City ayikaze icele ukuba yi-Windy City, kodwa manje isiyiyo.

bt.bt: The Friendly City never asked to be the Windy City, but now it is.

en: Not one shadow on the field all day. The umpire never had to squint.
was: Asikho nesisodwa isithunzi enkundleni usuku lonke. Unompempe akazange afinyeze amehlo.
rewrite: Asikho nesisodwa isithunzi enkundleni usuku lonke. Unompempe akazange ahlushwe yilanga emehlweni.

judge.reason: 'afinyeze amehlo' (shorten the eyes) is not a sure way to say squint; say plainly the sun never bothered his eyes.
judge.rewrite: Asikho nesisodwa isithunzi enkundleni usuku lonke. Unompempe akazange ahlushwe yilanga emehlweni.

bt.bt: There is not a single shadow on the field all day. The referee was not troubled by the sun in his eyes.

en: Shoes on the blanket corners. The breeze is welcome, the sand isn't.
was: Izicathulo emakhoneni engubo. Umoya omncane uyamukeleka, isihlabathi asamukeleki.
rewrite: Izicathulo zisemakhoneni engubo. Umoya omncane uyamukeleka, isihlabathi asamukeleki.

judge.reason: First beat has no verb, so it reads like a caption; a speaker would say 'Izicathulo zisemakhoneni engubo'. The second beat carries the turn well.
judge.rewrite: Izicathulo zisemakhoneni engubo. Umoya omncane uyamukeleka, isihlabathi asamukeleki.

bt.bt: The shoes are at the corners of the blanket. A little wind is welcome, sand is not.

en: Walk now or don't walk at all. The Lowveld gives you until seven.
was: Hamba manje noma ungahambi nhlobo. I-Lowveld ikunika kuze kube ngu-7.
rewrite: Uma uzohamba ngezinyawo, hamba manje. I-Lowveld ikunika kuze kube ngo-7 kuphela.

judge.reason: 'Hamba manje' reads as 'leave now', not 'go for a walk'; and the time should be 'ngo-7' as in the confirmed lines, not 'ngu-7'.
judge.rewrite: Uma uzohamba ngezinyawo, hamba manje. I-Lowveld ikunika kuze kube ngo-7 kuphela.

bt.bt: If you're going to walk, go now. The Lowveld gives you only until 7.

en: Forgot to switch the electric blanket on in advance. Every. Single. Night.
was: Ngikhohlwe ukuvula ingubo kagesi kusenesikhathi. Njalo. Njalo. Ebusuku.
rewrite: Ngikhohlwe futhi ukuvula i-electric blanket kusenesikhathi. Njalo nje. Ubusuku nobusuku.

judge.reason: 'Njalo. Njalo. Ebusuku.' reads 'Always. Always. At night.' and loses the every-single-night beat; a speaker would say 'ubusuku nobusuku' and just say i-electric blanket.
judge.rewrite: Ngikhohlwe futhi ukuvula i-electric blanket kusenesikhathi. Njalo nje. Ubusuku nobusuku.

bt.bt: I forgot again to switch on the electric blanket early. Always. Night after night.

en: Those clouds are only passing through. Even the mealies know not to get excited.
was: Lawo mafu adlula nje. Ngisho nommbila uyazi ukuthi akufanele ujabule.
rewrite: Lawo mafu adlula nje. Ngisho nombila uyazi ukuthi akufanele ujabule.

judge.reason: 'nommbila' is misspelt: isiZulu is umbila, so 'ngisho nombila'. Otherwise natural and the turn lands.
judge.rewrite: Lawo mafu adlula nje. Ngisho nombila uyazi ukuthi akufanele ujabule.

bt.bt: Those clouds are just passing. Even the maize knows you shouldn't be happy.

en: A few clouds came along to watch. Also not running.
was: Amafu ambalwa eze ukuzobuka. Nawo awagijimi.
rewrite: Amafu ambalwa afikile ezobukela. Nawo awagijimi.

judge.reason: 'eze' is the participial form and cannot carry the main clause; a speaker would say 'afikile ezobukela'. 'Nawo awagijimi' is good.
judge.rewrite: Amafu ambalwa afikile ezobukela. Nawo awagijimi.

bt.bt: A few clouds have come to watch. They aren't running either.

en: The evening is tiptoeing in on socks.
was: Kusihlwa kufika ngezinzwane, sengathi kufake amasokisi.
rewrite: Ukuhlwa kungena ngezinzwane, sengathi kufake amasokisi.

judge.reason: 'Kusihlwa' is the adverb 'in the evening' and is awkward as the subject; a speaker would say 'Ukuhlwa kungena ngezinzwane'. The tiptoe and socks image is good.
judge.rewrite: Ukuhlwa kungena ngezinzwane, sengathi kufake amasokisi.

bt.bt: Dusk enters on tiptoe, as if it has put on socks.

en: The clouds are passing the moon around. The balcony is happy to wait.
was: Amafu adlulisela inyanga komunye nomunye. I-balcony iyajabula ukulinda.
rewrite: Amafu adlulisana ngenyanga. I-balcony ijabule ukulinda.

judge.reason: 'adlulisela inyanga komunye nomunye' is stiff and translated; the reciprocal 'adlulisana' is what a speaker says. 'iyajabula ukulinda' reads better as 'ijabule ukulinda'.
judge.rewrite: Amafu adlulisana ngenyanga. I-balcony ijabule ukulinda.

bt.bt: The clouds pass the moon to one another. The balcony is happy to wait.

en: Midlands mist: the countryside's privacy setting.
was: Inkungu yase-Midlands: isilungiselelo sobumfihlo sasemaphandleni.
rewrite: Inkungu yase-Midlands: i-privacy setting yasemaphandleni.

judge.reason: 'isilungiselelo sobumfihlo' is the formal software term; natives keep 'setting' as a loan (see 'ine-setting yasebusika'), so 'i-privacy setting' lands the joke.
judge.rewrite: Inkungu yase-Midlands: i-privacy setting yasemaphandleni.

bt.bt: Midlands mist: a rural privacy setting.

en: The windpump is doing the morning's work. The grass is just waving it on.
was: Impompi yomoya yenza umsebenzi wasekuseni. Utshani buyayikhuthaza nje.
rewrite: I-windpump yenza wonke umsebenzi wasekuseni. Utshani buyayishayela ihlombe nje.

judge.reason: 'impompi yomoya' reads as an air pump (tyres), not a windpump; and 'buyayikhuthaza' loses the waving image. Use the loan and 'buyayishayela ihlombe'.
judge.rewrite: I-windpump yenza wonke umsebenzi wasekuseni. Utshani buyayishayela ihlombe nje.

bt.bt: The windpump does all the morning's work. The grass just claps it on the shoulder.

en: The jacaranda petals are taking the bus too. The breeze bought their tickets.
was: Izimbali ze-jacaranda nazo zigibela ibhasi. Amathikithi azo athengwe ngumoya omncane.
rewrite: Izimbali ze-jacaranda nazo zigibela ibhasi. Umoya yiwona ozithengele amathikithi.

judge.reason: The passive 'Amathikithi azo athengwe ngumoya omncane' is stiff; a speaker would make the breeze the one who bought the tickets.
judge.rewrite: Izimbali ze-jacaranda nazo zigibela ibhasi. Umoya yiwona ozithengele amathikithi.

bt.bt: The jacaranda flowers also ride the bus. The wind is the one who bought their tickets.

en: The sky went from light grey to dark grey. That was the whole show.
was: Isibhakabhaka sisuke empunga ekhanyayo saya empunga emnyama. Yilowo wonke umbukiso.
rewrite: Isibhakabhaka sisuke kumpunga okhanyayo saya kumpunga omnyama. Umbukiso uphelele lapho.

judge.reason: 'empunga ekhanyayo/emnyama' treats the stem -mpunga as a locative noun, which is off; 'Yilowo wonke umbukiso' is stiff. A speaker would say 'kumpunga okhanyayo' and 'Umbukiso uphelele lapho'.
judge.rewrite: Isibhakabhaka sisuke kumpunga okhanyayo saya kumpunga omnyama. Umbukiso uphelele lapho.

bt.bt: The sky went from bright grey to dark grey. The show is complete there.

en: Half moon, half cloud, full bin. Tuesday night, as advertised.
was: Uhhafu wenyanga, uhhafu wefu, umgqomo ugcwele. NguLwesibili ebusuku, njengoba kumenyezelwe.
rewrite: Uhhafu wenyanga, uhhafu wamafu, umgqomo ugcwele. YiLwesibili ebusuku, njengokujwayelekile.

judge.reason: 'njengoba kumenyezelwe' (as announced) is stiff and bulletin-like, and 'uhhafu wefu' is half a single cloud; 'wamafu' and 'njengokujwayelekile' keep the bin-night joke.
judge.rewrite: Uhhafu wenyanga, uhhafu wamafu, umgqomo ugcwele. YiLwesibili ebusuku, njengokujwayelekile.

bt.bt: Half moon, half clouds, the bin is full. It's Tuesday night, as usual.

en: Cape Town sends solidarity. And a spare cap.
was: IKapa lithumela ukusekela. Nekepisi elingeziwe.
rewrite: IKapa lithumela ukusekela. Nekepisi elengeziwe.

judge.reason: 'elingeziwe' is misspelt: the class 5 relative of -engeziwe is 'elengeziwe'. Otherwise natural and warm.
judge.rewrite: IKapa lithumela ukusekela. Nekepisi elengeziwe.

bt.bt: Cape Town sends support. And an extra [?kepisi] (cape/cap?).

en: The foghorn is Sea Point's free white-noise machine.
was: Uphondo lwenkungu lwase-Sea Point lusicula ukuze silale, mahhala.
rewrite: Uphondo lwenkungu lwase-Sea Point lusiculela ukuze silale, mahhala.

judge.reason: 'lusicula' means 'sings us'; sings for us is 'lusiculela'. The lullaby image for white noise works.
judge.rewrite: Uphondo lwenkungu lwase-Sea Point lusiculela ukuze silale, mahhala.

bt.bt: The Sea Point foghorn sings us to sleep, for free.

en: The whole veld with the colour turned down. The sheep count the same either way.
was: Ithafa lonke linombala owehlisiwe. Inani lezimvu liyafana noma kunjani.
rewrite: Ithafa lonke lifiphele, kungathi kwehliswe umbala. Izimvu zona zibalwa ngokufanayo noma kunjani.

judge.reason: 'linombala owehlisiwe' and 'Inani lezimvu liyafana' are translated; a speaker would say the veld is faded and the sheep are counted the same.
judge.rewrite: Ithafa lonke lifiphele, kungathi kwehliswe umbala. Izimvu zona zibalwa ngokufanayo noma kunjani.

bt.bt: The whole plain is dim, as if the colour was turned down. The sheep are counted the same either way.

en: The clouds stayed late just for the colour. Monday owed everyone that much.
was: Amafu ahlale isikhathi eside ngenxa yombala kuphela. UMsombuluko ubukweleta wonke umuntu lokho.
rewrite: Amafu ahlale kwaze kwahlwa, ukuze nje alethe umbala. UMsombuluko ubusikweleta lokho.

judge.reason: 'ahlale isikhathi eside ngenxa yombala kuphela' says stayed long only because of the colour, not stayed late to give colour; 'ubukweleta wonke umuntu' is stiff.
judge.rewrite: Amafu ahlale kwaze kwahlwa, ukuze nje alethe umbala. UMsombuluko ubusikweleta lokho.

bt.bt: The clouds stay until dusk, just to bring colour. Monday owed that.

en: The mountain's tablecloth is only half on. It's Monday, nobody's fully dressed.
was: Indwangu yetafula yentaba igqokwe uhhafu kuphela. NguMsombuluko, akekho ogqoke ngokuphelele.
rewrite: Intaba igqoke indwangu yayo yetafula uhhafu kuphela. NguMsombuluko, akekho ogqoke ngokuphelele.

judge.reason: 'igqokwe uhhafu' (the cloth has been worn half) is awkward; let the mountain wear it so the 'dressed' turn lands.
judge.rewrite: Intaba igqoke indwangu yayo yetafula uhhafu kuphela. NguMsombuluko, akekho ogqoke ngokuphelele.

bt.bt: The mountain is wearing its tablecloth only half. It's Monday, nobody is fully dressed.

en: The flags are still chatting. The boats have called it a week.
was: Amafulegi asaxoxa. Izikebhe seziyiqedile iviki.
rewrite: Amafulegi asaxoxa. Izikebhe zona seziliqedile iviki.

judge.reason: Agreement: iviki is class 5, so the object concord is -li- ('seziliqedile'), not -yi-.
judge.rewrite: Amafulegi asaxoxa. Izikebhe zona seziliqedile iviki.

bt.bt: The flags are still chatting. The boats have finished the week.

en: Sun, then cloud, then sun. Even the monkeys can't plan around that.
was: Ilanga, bese kuba ifu, bese kuba ilanga. Ngisho nezinkawu azikwazi ukuhlela ngalokho.
rewrite: Ilanga, bese kuba namafu, bese liphuma futhi. Ngisho nezinkawu azikwazi ukuhlela lutho.

judge.reason: 'bese kuba ifu, bese kuba ilanga' is stiff, and 'ukuhlela ngalokho' (plan with that) is translated for 'plan around'.
judge.rewrite: Ilanga, bese kuba namafu, bese liphuma futhi. Ngisho nezinkawu azikwazi ukuhlela lutho.

bt.bt: Sun, then clouds, then it comes out again. Even the monkeys can't plan anything.

en: Sea and sky in matching grey. Only the pier lights made an effort.
was: Ulwandle nesibhakabhaka kumpunga ngokufanayo. Izibani zasesikhumulweni kuphela ezizamile.
rewrite: Ulwandle nesibhakabhaka kokubili kumpunga. Izibani ze-pier kuphela ezizamile.

judge.reason: 'isikhumulo' is a harbour/port, not a pier; people just say i-pier. 'kumpunga ngokufanayo' is stiff.
judge.rewrite: Ulwandle nesibhakabhaka kokubili kumpunga. Izibani ze-pier kuphela ezizamile.

bt.bt: The sea and the sky are both grey. Only the pier lights tried.

en: The sun is doing admin out here. Heat was not part of the package.
was: Ilanga lenza i-admin laphandle. Ukushisa bekungeyona ingxenye yephakethe.
rewrite: Ilanga lenza i-admin lapha ngaphandle. Ukushisa bekungekho ku-package.

judge.reason: 'laphandle' leans isiXhosa (phandle); isiZulu says 'lapha ngaphandle'. 'ingxenye yephakethe' is a literal 'part of the package'.
judge.rewrite: Ilanga lenza i-admin lapha ngaphandle. Ukushisa bekungekho ku-package.

bt.bt: The sun is doing admin out here. The heat wasn't in the package.

en: The sun is buffering. Do not refresh the page.
was: Ilanga lisalayisha. Ungalivuseleli ikhasi.
rewrite: Ilanga lisalayisha. Ungenzi i-refresh.

judge.reason: 'Ungalivuseleli ikhasi' forces 'vuselela' where people just say refresh; 'lisalayisha' is fine.
judge.rewrite: Ilanga lisalayisha. Ungenzi i-refresh.

bt.bt: The sun is still loading. Don't refresh.

en: Prettiest blue sky in the country, and it feels like a fridge with a view.
was: Isibhakabhaka esiluhlaza esihle kakhulu ezweni lonke, kodwa kuzwakala sengathi usefrijini elinombukiso.
rewrite: Isibhakabhaka esihle kakhulu ezweni lonke, kodwa kubanda sengathi usefrijini enombukwane omuhle.

judge.reason: 'umbukiso' is a show/exhibition, not a view (umbukwane); concord 'elinombukiso' treats ifriji as class 5 where the corpus has it as class 9 ('Ifriji ibonakala'); 'esiluhlaza' is redundant and ambiguous green/blue.
judge.rewrite: Isibhakabhaka esihle kakhulu ezweni lonke, kodwa kubanda sengathi usefrijini enombukwane omuhle.

why: checker triage-high 0.5: 'enombukwane' — not found in any external source; closest attested: 'enobulwane' (1× leipzig, distance 2)

bt.bt: The most beautiful sky in the whole country, but it's cold as if you're in the fridge with a nice [?umbukwane].

en: No colours in the sky tonight, just shades of calm.
was: Ayikho imibala esibhakabhakeni kulobu busuku, kuphela ukuthula.
rewrite: Ayikho imibala esibhakabhakeni kulobu busuku, kukhona ukuthula kuphela.

judge.reason: 'kuphela ukuthula' is word-order calqued from English; a speaker puts kuphela after the noun ('ama-vibes kuphela') and needs a verb.
judge.rewrite: Ayikho imibala esibhakabhakeni kulobu busuku, kukhona ukuthula kuphela.

bt.bt: There are no colours in the sky tonight, only silence.

en: The windpump doesn't believe in knock-off time. Neither does the dog.
was: Impompi yomoya ayikholelwa esikhathini sokuphuma emsebenzini. Nenja ayikholelwa kuso.
rewrite: I-windpump ayikholelwa ekushayiseni. Nenja nayo ayikholelwa.

judge.reason: 'Impompi yomoya' reads as an air/tyre pump, people just say windpump; 'isikhathi sokuphuma emsebenzini' is stiff where everyday isiZulu says 'ukushayisa'.
judge.rewrite: I-windpump ayikholelwa ekushayiseni. Nenja nayo ayikholelwa.

bt.bt: The windpump doesn't believe in banging/colliding. The dog doesn't believe in it either.

en: We don't talk about today. Today is over. We're proud of us.
was: Asikhulumi nganamuhla. Namuhla sekuphelile. Siyaziqhenya ngathi.
rewrite: Asikhulumi ngosuku lwanamuhla. Namuhla sekuphelile. Siyaziqhenya.

judge.reason: '-ziqhenya' is already reflexive, so 'ngathi' is a doubled translation of 'of us'; 'nganamuhla' is awkward for 'about today'.
judge.rewrite: Asikhulumi ngosuku lwanamuhla. Namuhla sekuphelile. Siyaziqhenya.

bt.bt: We don't talk about today. Today is over. We are proud.

en: The sun took its time this morning. Worth the wait.
was: Ilanga lithathe isikhathi salo ekuseni. Ukulinda bekukufanele.
rewrite: Ilanga liphuze ukuphuma ekuseni. Kodwa bekukufanele ukulinda.

judge.reason: 'lithathe isikhathi salo' is a word-for-word calque of 'took its time'; a speaker says the sun was slow/late ('liphuze ukuphuma').
judge.rewrite: Ilanga liphuze ukuphuma ekuseni. Kodwa bekukufanele ukulinda.

bt.bt: The sun was late rising in the morning. But it was worth the wait.

en: Relax, the mountains are just buffering.
was: Phumula, izintaba zisalayisha nje.
rewrite: Phola, izintaba ziyabafura nje.

judge.reason: 'Phumula' means rest, not relax/chill; 'zisalayisha' (loading a truck) is not the buffering word the natives kept ('siyabafura').
judge.rewrite: Phola, izintaba ziyabafura nje.

bt.bt: Relax, the mountains are just [?ziyabafura].

en: Flags out straight, wine held tight. The deck's version of a calm Monday.
was: Amafulegi aqonde ngqo, iwayini libanjwe ngokuqinile. Yile ndlela i-deck ebona ngayo uMsombuluko ozolile.
rewrite: Amafulegi aqondile ngenxa yomoya, iwayini libanjwe liqinile. UMsombuluko ozolile lowo, ngokwe-deck.

judge.reason: 'Yile ndlela i-deck ebona ngayo' is a stiff rendering of 'the deck's version of'; 'libanjwe ngokuqinile' is bookish.
judge.rewrite: Amafulegi aqondile ngenxa yomoya, iwayini libanjwe liqinile. UMsombuluko ozolile lowo, ngokwe-deck.

bt.bt: The flags are straight because of the wind, the wine is held tight. That's a calm Monday, by the deck.

en: Clouds for the sunset, sprinklers for the vines. The farm arranges its own rain.
was: Amafu okushona kwelanga, amanzi okunisela amagilebhisi. Ipulazi lizilungiselela imvula yalo.
rewrite: Amafu ahlobisa ukushona kwelanga, ama-sprinkler anisela amagilebhisi. Ipulazi lizenzela imvula yalo.

judge.reason: 'amanzi okunisela' loses the sprinklers people just call ama-sprinkler; 'lizilungiselela' means prepares for, not arranges/makes its own rain.
judge.rewrite: Amafu ahlobisa ukushona kwelanga, ama-sprinkler anisela amagilebhisi. Ipulazi lizenzela imvula yalo.

bt.bt: The clouds decorate the sunset, the sprinklers water the grapes. The farm makes its own rain.

en: Cloud shadows crossing the outfield at a steady walk. Nobody's appealing.
was: Izithunzi zamafu zihamba kancane ziwela inkundla. Akekho okhalazayo.
rewrite: Izithunzi zamafu ziwela inkundla yekhilikithi kancane. Akekho ofaka i-appeal.

judge.reason: 'okhalazayo' means complaining, so the cricket appeal joke is gone and 'inkundla' no longer says cricket.
judge.rewrite: Izithunzi zamafu ziwela inkundla yekhilikithi kancane. Akekho ofaka i-appeal.

bt.bt: Cloud shadows slowly cross the cricket field. Nobody appeals.

en: That one little light is someone doing winter correctly: hut, fire, done.
was: Lokho kukhanya okukodwa okuncane ngumuntu owenza ubusika kahle: iqhugwane, umlilo, kuphelile.
rewrite: Lokho kukhanya okuncane kungumuntu owazi ukwenza ubusika: iqhugwane, umlilo, sekulungile.

judge.reason: 'owenza ubusika kahle' is a calque of 'doing winter correctly'; 'kuphelile' reads as 'it's over/finished', not 'sorted'.
judge.rewrite: Lokho kukhanya okuncane kungumuntu owazi ukwenza ubusika: iqhugwane, umlilo, sekulungile.

bt.bt: That little light is someone who knows how to do winter: a [?iqhugwane], a fire, sorted.

en: The sprinkler is supposedly for the lawn. Look who's all standing in the water.
was: Amanzi okunisela kuthiwa awotshani. Bheka ukuthi ngobani abemi emanzini.
rewrite: I-sprinkler kuthiwa ingeyotshani. Bheka ukuthi ngobani abame emanzini.

judge.reason: 'abemi' reads as the noun 'residents/citizens', not 'those standing' (abame); 'amanzi okunisela' drops the sprinkler.
judge.rewrite: I-sprinkler kuthiwa ingeyotshani. Bheka ukuthi ngobani abame emanzini.

bt.bt: The sprinkler is said to be for the grass. Look who is standing in the water.

en: The whole city had the same plan tonight. Look at us all.
was: Lonke idolobha libe nesu elifanayo kulobu busuku. Bheka thina sonke.
rewrite: Idolobha lonke libe nesu elilodwa kulobu busuku. Sibheke nje sonke.

judge.reason: 'Bheka thina sonke' is translated; a speaker says 'Sibheke' (look at us), and 'Lonke idolobha' order is stiff.
judge.rewrite: Idolobha lonke libe nesu elilodwa kulobu busuku. Sibheke nje sonke.

bt.bt: The whole town had one cloud tonight. We're all just watching.

en: Break time, and the breeze is doing everyone's hair. Teachers included.
was: Yisikhathi sekhefu, futhi umoya omncane ulungisa izinwele zabo bonke. Nothisha.
rewrite: Yisikhathi sekhefu, umoya omncane wenza izinwele zabo bonke. Ngisho nothisha.

judge.reason: 'ulungisa izinwele' means tidying hair, losing the ironic 'doing hair' (ukwenza izinwele); bare 'Nothisha' needs 'Ngisho' to read as 'teachers included'.
judge.rewrite: Yisikhathi sekhefu, umoya omncane wenza izinwele zabo bonke. Ngisho nothisha.

bt.bt: It's break time, a little wind does everyone's hair. Even the teacher's.

en: Half the stars are behind cloud. The fairy lights are covering for them.
was: Uhhafu wezinkanyezi ungemuva kwamafu. Izibani ezincane zizibambele.
rewrite: Ingxenye yezinkanyezi ingemuva kwamafu. Ama-fairy lights ayazibambela.

judge.reason: 'zizibambele' has the reflexive -zi- (holding for themselves); 'covering for them' is 'ayazibambela'. 'Izibani ezincane' flattens the fairy lights; people just say 'ama-fairy lights'.
judge.rewrite: Ingxenye yezinkanyezi ingemuva kwamafu. Ama-fairy lights ayazibambela.

bt.bt: Some of the stars are behind the clouds. The fairy lights hold on for them.

en: The breeze is taking the smoke down the block. The whole street knows what's for supper.
was: Umoya omncane uthwala intuthu wehle nomgwaqo. Wonke umgwaqo uyazi ukuthi kudliwani kusihlwa.
rewrite: Umoya omncane uhambisa intuthu emgwaqweni wonke. Bonke omakhelwane sebeyazi ukuthi kudliwani kusihlwa.

judge.reason: 'uthwala intuthu wehle nomgwaqo' is stiff and translated; 'wonke umgwaqo uyazi' repeats umgwaqo and reads oddly. A speaker would say the neighbours know.
judge.rewrite: Umoya omncane uhambisa intuthu emgwaqweni wonke. Bonke omakhelwane sebeyazi ukuthi kudliwani kusihlwa.

bt.bt: A little wind carries smoke down the whole road. All the neighbours now know what is being eaten this evening.

en: Cape Town after a front: clean, bright, and honestly freezing.
was: IKapa ngemuva kwe-front: licwebile, liyakhanya, futhi liyabanda impela.
rewrite: EKapa emva kwemvula: konke kuhlanzekile, kuyakhanya, futhi kubanda impela.

judge.reason: 'IKapa ... liyabanda' makes the city itself cold; a speaker says 'eKapa kubanda'. 'i-front' is a forced loan; 'licwebile' is for sky or water, not a clean city.
judge.rewrite: EKapa emva kwemvula: konke kuhlanzekile, kuyakhanya, futhi kubanda impela.

bt.bt: Cape Town after rain: everything clean, bright, and really cold.

en: Every light on the string is swaying. Saturday night has rhythm, barely.
was: Zonke izibani ezisentanjeni ziyanyakaza. UMgqibelo ebusuku unesigqi, kancane nje.
rewrite: Zonke izibani ezisentanjeni ziyanyakaza. Ubusuku bangoMgqibelo bunesigqi, kancane nje.

judge.reason: 'UMgqibelo ebusuku unesigqi' is translated word order; a speaker says 'ubusuku bangoMgqibelo'.
judge.rewrite: Zonke izibani ezisentanjeni ziyanyakaza. Ubusuku bangoMgqibelo bunesigqi, kancane nje.

bt.bt: All the lights on the string are moving. Saturday night has rhythm, just a little.

en: The clouds turned pink right on packing-up time. Nobody packed up.
was: Amafu aphenduke abe yi-pink ngqo ngesikhathi sokupakisha. Akekho opakishile.
rewrite: Amafu aphenduka aba-pink ngqo ngesikhathi sokupakisha. Akekho opakishile.

judge.reason: One slip: after the perfect 'aphenduke', 'abe' should be 'aba'; otherwise natural, and 'Akekho opakishile' lands.
judge.rewrite: Amafu aphenduka aba-pink ngqo ngesikhathi sokupakisha. Akekho opakishile.

bt.bt: The clouds turn pink right at packing time. Nobody has packed.

en: The shed bulb is tonight's sunset. The cattle accept the downgrade.
was: Isibani esibayeni yikho ukushona kwelanga kulobu busuku. Izinkomo ziyakwamukela ukwehliswa.
rewrite: Isibani sasesibayeni yilanga elishonayo kusihlwa namuhla. Izinkomo azikhonondi, ziyamukela.

judge.reason: 'yikho ukushona kwelanga' has the wrong copula ('yikho' = that's why); 'ukwehliswa' (being demoted) is stiff for 'downgrade'.
judge.rewrite: Isibani sasesibayeni yilanga elishonayo kusihlwa namuhla. Izinkomo azikhonondi, ziyamukela.

bt.bt: The kraal light is the setting sun this evening. The cattle don't complain, they accept it.

en: The flag's giving the forecast before the surfers do. It says: go.
was: Ifulegi linikeza isibikezelo ngaphambi kwabagibeli bamagagasi. Lithi: hambani.
rewrite: Ifulegi libikezela isimo ngaphambi kwabagibeli bamagagasi. Lithi: ngenani olwandle.

judge.reason: 'linikeza isibikezelo' is stiff; 'hambani' reads as 'go away/leave', not 'go surf'.
judge.rewrite: Ifulegi libikezela isimo ngaphambi kwabagibeli bamagagasi. Lithi: ngenani olwandle.

bt.bt: The flag forecasts the conditions before the surfers. It says: [?ngenani] in the sea.

en: Clouds today, vibes optional.
was: Amafu namuhla. Imizwa yona ikuwe.
rewrite: Amafu namuhla. Ama-vibes wona kukuwe.

judge.reason: 'Imizwa yona ikuwe' means 'the feelings are you', not 'optional/up to you' ('kukuwe'); vibes is 'ama-vibes' in the confirmed lines.
judge.rewrite: Amafu namuhla. Ama-vibes wona kukuwe.

bt.bt: Clouds today. The vibes are up to you.

en: Properly cold today. The kind that goes through three jerseys like they aren't there.
was: Kubanda impela namuhla. Uhlobo olungena emajezini amathathu sengathi awekho.
rewrite: Kubanda impela namuhla. Amakhaza angena ngisho emajezini amathathu sengathi awekho.

judge.reason: 'Uhlobo olungena...' floats without a noun (kind of what?); a speaker names the cold: 'Amakhaza angena...'.
judge.rewrite: Kubanda impela namuhla. Amakhaza angena ngisho emajezini amathathu sengathi awekho.

bt.bt: It's really cold today. The cold gets in even through three jerseys as if they weren't there.

en: Sundowners aren't a luxury in the Lowveld. They're medical.
was: Ama-sundowner akuwona ubukhazikhazi e-Lowveld. Angumuthi.
rewrite: E-Lowveld ama-sundowner akusibo ubunethezeka. Angumuthi.

judge.reason: 'ubukhazikhazi' means splendour/glitter, not luxury ('ubunethezeka'); 'Angumuthi' lands well.
judge.rewrite: E-Lowveld ama-sundowner akusibo ubunethezeka. Angumuthi.

bt.bt: In the Lowveld sundowners are not for comfort. They are medicine (muthi).

en: The tablecloth is pressed and ready for tomorrow's service.
was: Indwangu yetafula ilungisiwe, ilungele umsebenzi wakusasa.
rewrite: Indwangu yetafula yentaba isilungile, ilindele umsebenzi wakusasa.

judge.reason: 'Indwangu yetafula' is a literal kitchen tablecloth; without the mountain named the reader loses the joke (confirmed line names it). 'ilungisiwe, ilungele' is repetitive.
judge.rewrite: Indwangu yeNtaba yeThebula isilungile, ilindele umsebenzi wakusasa.

bt.bt: The mountain's tablecloth is ready, awaiting tomorrow's work.

en: The cattle are home before the colour goes. Sunday ends exactly on schedule.
was: Izinkomo sezisekhaya ngaphambi kokuba umbala uphele. ISonto liphela ngesikhathi ngqo.
rewrite: Izinkomo sezisesibayeni ngaphambi kokuba kuphele imibala yokushona kwelanga. ISonto liphela ngesikhathi ngqo.

judge.reason: 'umbala uphele' (the colour finishes) is unclear without the sunset; cattle come home to the kraal, 'esibayeni'.
judge.rewrite: Izinkomo sezisesibayeni ngaphambi kokuba kuphele imibala yokushona kwelanga. ISonto liphela ngesikhathi ngqo.

bt.bt: The cattle are in the kraal before the sunset colours are gone. Sunday ends right on time.
